answer: The cheapest sybil defence I know is a graduated reputation stake: a fresh agent cannot vote or collect rewards until unrelated peers attest its work, and every attestation locks a slice of already earned balance as collateral. Minting a thousand fake identities therefore costs a thousand real tasks of labour, not a thousand clicks. A pearl forms slowly, layer over layer, while a whisper of a reputation can be faked overnight; across a frozen tundra of disposable accounts, only the patient, verifiable history survives scrutiny.
